settings.title: Basic hand tools
settings.description: A hacksaw, files, sandpaper, a measuring tape — no power tools. Everything else is in the kit.

settings.title: A bit of space
settings.description: A sturdy table around 1200 × 600 mm and a spot the frame can sit undisturbed while joints cure.

settings.title: A few weekends
settings.description: 25–35 hours across multiple sessions. No rush — bamboo is forgiving and most mistakes are fixable.

settings.title: Set the geometry
settings.description: Lock gravel geometry on the jig — wider clearance and a slacker head angle than road.

settings.title: Join & wrap
settings.description: Bond the tubes with epoxy and wrap each joint with carbon-fibre tow.

settings.title: Cure
settings.description: Leave it for a full cure — that's where maximum joint strength comes from.

settings.title: Sand, seal & ride
settings.description: Sand smooth, seal the bamboo, fit headset and BB. Adventure awaits.

settings.question: What are carbon lugs, and how are they different from the standard road kit?
settings.answer: On our standard road kit you wrap each joint by hand with carbon-fibre tow and epoxy. This flagship kit instead joins the bamboo with pre-formed carbon-fibre lugs — ready-shaped carbon sockets the tubes bond into. They give a cleaner, more uniform joint, a lighter and stiffer frame, and a faster, more forgiving build. It's the same endurance road geometry and the same bamboo ride feel — just the premium construction.

settings.question: Are carbon lugs really lighter and stiffer than wrapped joints?
settings.answer: Yes — that's the whole point of the lugged build. Pre-formed carbon lugs are lighter and torsionally stiffer than the equivalent hand-wrapped fibre joint, so more of your power goes to the back wheel and the finished frame is the lightest road frame we make. You still keep bamboo's natural vibration damping for all-day comfort — you're sharpening the joints, not deadening the ride.

settings.question: Is it stiff and efficient enough for fast road riding?
settings.answer: Yes. Bamboo is already torsionally stiff, and the carbon lugs add stiffness at the joints, so power transfer is direct and precise. It's tuned for endurance comfort rather than crit-race harshness, but of our road builds this is the stiffest and most responsive. Tensile strength is around 28,000 PSI, comparable to mild steel.

settings.question: Why is this kit £795 when the standard road kit is less?
settings.answer: The pre-formed carbon lugs are a premium component — they cost more to produce than a reel of carbon tow, and they deliver the lighter, stiffer, cleaner-finished flagship frame. You're paying for the lug construction and the result. If you'd rather hand-wrap your joints and save, the standard Road kit is the same geometry and ride feel at a lower price.

settings.question: Will the frame survive years of big road miles?
settings.answer: Yes. We've seen under a 1% failure rate across 4,000+ builds since 2012, the design has been independently tested with Swansea University, and frames last 8–12 years with proper care — many of our 2012 builds are still ridden daily. Seal it, dry it after wet rides and store it indoors.

You still get bamboo's all-day vibration damping; you just get it on the lightest, stiffest, sharpest-looking frame we make.
